==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

==Trivia==
* {{PAGENAME}} is the first Original Character from this game.
* {{PAGENAME}} is one of the first banner units to be added to Anime Adventures since the re-release of the game.
* Honey is the first mythic character that does NOT have an AOE because her AOE comes from her passive
* Honey (Hive) has the lowest takedown requirement of any unit to evolve, only requiring 100.
* Honey is currently the fastest Mythical unit in the game.
* Mirrorblade is the most recomended [[Relics|relic]] due to her attack speed
